description: This file is a Shell script used for testing the behavior of Git pack-objects, specifically focusing on delta chains, pack creation, and depth configurations in the Git version control system. It includes setup for repeated commits, pack generation, and verification of delta chain lengths under different conditions.

methods.name: max_chain
methods.description: Function to verify the length of the delta chain in a given pack by analyzing the output of 'git index-pack --verify-stat-only'.
